thread:
Lara M: Dropping a quick thread on the usage dashboard layout options. Two competing ideas: (1) compact rows with inline token badges + expandable micro-details, (2) full detail side panel that slides in. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ghi789/usage-dashboard-ux
Toby N: Compact rows save vertical space and are nicer on narrow viewports, but expansion per row feels janky if we load token timelines synchronously. Prefer side panel for heavier payloads.
Ravi S: Performance note: we should lazy-load any timelines and use a small summary payload for the table rows. If we do inline expansion, virtualize the table and only render expanded content for visible rows.
Helena V: Accessibility concerns: expanded inline content can be difficult for screen reader users if it shifts content. Side panel (role=dialog) is simpler for focus management. Also use semantic table markup and provide skip links to the table for keyboard users.
A11yBot: Checklist suggestions:
- Side panel must implement focus trap + return focus on close
- Expanded rows should use aria-expanded on the trigger and aria-controls pointing to the content region
- Ensure token badge text meets 4.5:1 contrast or use larger text
- Provide text-summary above heatmaps for screen readers
Example: <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="invoice-3456-details">Show details</button>
EngBot: Small implementation detail: side panel should be at /billing/:invoiceId?panel=details in the URL so its linkable and back-button friendly. We can use history.pushState to avoid full reloads.
Lara M: Copy questions: use "Organization" vs "Account" in header? Suggest unify on "Organization" across the product. Also explicit CTA "Download invoice (CSV)" rather than just "Export".
Toby N: UX idea: add a tiny sparkline in the token badge (SVG 64x16) with aria-hidden and provide textual alt nearby, e.g., "token trend +9%". That gives visual cue without exposing noise to screen readers.
Ravi S: For exports, default CSV columns: invoice_id, date, org_name, project_name, total_cost, token_count. Add an "Include per-route costs" toggle in the export modal for advanced users.
Helena V: Mobile: collapse table to a card list and show primary info (invoice date, total cost, tokens). Provide a single "View details" button that opens the panel; avoid inline expand on mobile.
Lara M: Proposed resolution: use side panel by default for desktop; compact rows with sparklines and token badges in table; mobile uses card list + panel. Persist density toggle per user. We'll A/B test inline vs panel on 10% of traffic.
Toby N: Action items:
- Toby: prototype side panel focus flow + URL navigation (due Thu)
- Ravi: implement lightweight row API (include sparkline data + token summary) and streaming timeline endpoint (due Fri)
- Helena: write accessibility acceptance criteria and test plan (due Wed)
- Lara: update Figma with copy changes and mobile card layout (due Mon)
Lara M: Quick poll: react with :one: for inline-expansion, :two: for side-panel default. Please add short note if you vote for inline.
Toby N: :two:
Ravi S: :two:
Helena V: :two:
A11yBot: Added accessibility ticket and checklist to the design file.
